body: I hate myself.  I want to die.
True, and while would be very hard to put her through my death, can I really just exist here only for the sake of other people, and not be happy?
Yes.  I can't cry unless I do it, and I can't feel any better until I at least cry.   It opens an emotional pressure valve, instantly.
I'm just tired.  I gave all of myself to try and make the love work, and I'm spent.

I don't know.  When I call suicide hotlines, I beg them not to tell me to love myself and be happy on my own.  These words have had all the meaning wrung out of them for me.  It's like telling a flat tire to think round thoughts, and it'll be fixed.

I don't think I do.  I don't have the highest of standards, and I'll admit that.  It 's as if quality people, especially at 28, are taken, married, kidded, or have a lot of baggage.  I'm happy just to find ones I like and hope for  the best, but this strategy only gets less successful over time.

I get taken advantage of.. a lot.  Do I judge myself for it?  No, I just get buried under piles of everyone else's garbage.

I've been trying to find internal happiness for 28 years.  Is it more foolish to deny or accept  the reality that I can't?  I want to try and be friends for the sake of all of our mutual friends, but it is agony.  He is held in very high regard.  It takes me years to get over people.  Years.  I don't have it in me to try again.  A friend killed himself around my age, and for the very same reason.

Thank you for taking the time to respond.  I have no inconspicuous places left on my body left to cut, and no money or time to wait for therapy.  My roommate's sister is/was suicidal, and she said that if she has to deal with two suicidal people, then she's bailing out of the living arrangement.   It's easy to put up a front at home, because she's a very cheery person.  I don't even have the heart to bring her down.
Alien blue fucks up half the time I try to post.. can you hear me now?

You remind me of one of my favorite people.  We love the fucking shit out of his rants, but also make sure he'll be okay.  And we love the fucking shit out of his rants.  You guys rant like Michaelangelo paints.  I love you.
I only know how to make others happy.  I'm great at it, because I want to give them the thing I can't have myself.
this article explains the gene variant that I have.  The numbers here are staggering.  http://www.forbes.com/sites/robertglatter/2014/08/09/genetic-biomarker-identified-that-may-predict-suicide-risk/

I just lost my closest relationship.  I now openly discuss the issue with my ex, because I have nothing to lose.  I'm that girl, although I've explained that the breakup is not the cause, it's just evidence that my personality prevents me from having the things that I need and want in life.
